sources.name: The phytochemical diversity of commercial Cannabis in the United States — published dataset
sources.notes: Published cleaned laboratory dataset spanning multiple U.S. testing labs. Preserve sample-level records and dataset-normalized strain_slug; do not turn cultivar labels into fixed chemistry values.
